sources.title: GitHub - volcengine/OpenViking: Self-evolving Context Database for AI ...
sources.snippet: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents. It stores memories, resources, and skills as one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so an agent browses its own context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store.
